integrity: All finite assertions are backed by two standalone, independently constructed exact-state verifiers with complete state-space and all-source distance traversal.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite theorem for GP(10,2), not a general connectivity theorem; prior optimum counts and unrestricted exchange classification explicitly excluded. The accessible portions of a closely related 2023 paper do not cover the adjacent-only statement, but its complete text was unavailable. No independent audit performed.
title: Adjacent-token connectivity and sharp distance in dodecahedral minimum feedback sets
